title: "CW10-He2018_Decapping_Processing"
output: html_document
---

# He et al. 2018 (eLife, GSE107841) -- Decapping activators
# pat1Δ, lsm1Δ, dhh1Δ vs WT RNA-seq (deletion strains, YPD)
# CAVEAT: deletion strains -- transcriptional buffering likely as per Vijjamarri
# Output: tables/df_he2018_gba.txt
#         figures/He2018_decapping_scatter.png

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

col_small <- "#784283"
col_large <- "#ffa8cb"
col_A    <- "#e5000c"

load("scripts/gba_functions.rda")

clean_df <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(!grepl("unspliced", id)) %>%
    mutate(gene_id = str_split_fixed(id, "_", 2)[, 1]) %>%
    filter(grepl("^Y", gene_id)) %>%
    distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
}
```

```{r load-data}
df_pat1 <- read_tsv("tables/GSE107841_wt_pat1_expressions.txt.gz",
                    show_col_types = FALSE)

df_lsm1 <- read_tsv("tables/GSE107841_wt_lsm1_expressions.txt.gz",
                    show_col_types = FALSE)

df_dhh1 <- read_tsv("tables/GSE107841_wt_dhh1_expressions.txt.gz",
                    show_col_types = FALSE)

df_fc <- read_tsv("output_tables/df_WT_consensus_hl_fc.txt",
                  show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("pat1 columns:", paste(colnames(df_pat1), collapse=", "), "\n")
```

```{r process}
df_pat1_clean <- clean_df(df_pat1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(wt_pat1_log2FoldChange), is.finite(wt_pat1_log2FoldChange)) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, wt_pat1_log2FoldChange)

df_lsm1_clean <- clean_df(df_lsm1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(wt_lsm1_log2FoldChange), is.finite(wt_lsm1_log2FoldChange)) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, wt_lsm1_log2FoldChange)

df_dhh1_clean <- clean_df(df_dhh1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(wt_dhh1_log2FoldChange), is.finite(wt_dhh1_log2FoldChange)) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, wt_dhh1_log2FoldChange)

cat("pat1Δ genes:", nrow(df_pat1_clean), "\n")
cat("lsm1Δ genes:", nrow(df_lsm1_clean), "\n")
cat("dhh1Δ genes:", nrow(df_dhh1_clean), "\n")
```

```{r merge}
df_he2018 <- df_pat1_clean %>%
  full_join(df_lsm1_clean, by = "gene_id") %>%
  full_join(df_dhh1_clean, by = "gene_id")

colnames(df_he2018) <- c("gene_id", "log2FC_pat1D", "log2FC_lsm1D", "log2FC_dhh1D")

cat("Genes in merged table:", nrow(df_he2018), "\n")
summary(df_he2018[, c("log2FC_pat1D", "log2FC_lsm1D", "log2FC_dhh1D")])
```

```{r sanity-check}
r_pat1_lsm1 <- cor(df_he2018$log2FC_pat1D, df_he2018$log2FC_lsm1D,
                   method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
r_pat1_dhh1 <- cor(df_he2018$log2FC_pat1D, df_he2018$log2FC_dhh1D,
                   method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
r_lsm1_dhh1 <- cor(df_he2018$log2FC_lsm1D, df_he2018$log2FC_dhh1D,
                   method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")

cat("pat1Δ vs lsm1Δ R:", round(r_pat1_lsm1, 3), "\n")
cat("pat1Δ vs dhh1Δ R:", round(r_pat1_dhh1, 3), "\n")
cat("lsm1Δ vs dhh1Δ R:", round(r_lsm1_dhh1, 3), "\n")
```

```{r merge-fc}
df_merged <- df_he2018 %>%
  inner_join(df_fc, by = "gene_id")

cat("Genes after merging with WT hl FC:", nrow(df_merged), "\n")
```

```{r figure1-scatter}
r_pat1 <- cor(df_merged$log2FC_pat1D, df_merged$WT_hl_fc,
              method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
r_lsm1 <- cor(df_merged$log2FC_lsm1D, df_merged$WT_hl_fc,
              method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
r_dhh1 <- cor(df_merged$log2FC_dhh1D, df_merged$WT_hl_fc,
              method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")

cat("pat1Δ vs WT_hl_fc R:", round(r_pat1, 3), "\n")
cat("lsm1Δ vs WT_hl_fc R:", round(r_lsm1, 3), "\n")
cat("dhh1Δ vs WT_hl_fc R:", round(r_dhh1, 3), "\n")

make_scatter <- function(df, x_col, r_val, n_val, x_lab, pt_col) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[x_col]], y = WT_hl_fc)) +
    geom_point(colour = pt_col, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(colour = "black", se = FALSE, span = 0.4) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5,
             label = paste0("R = ", round(r_val, 3)),
             size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 3.2,
             label = paste0("n = ", format(n_val, big.mark = ",")),
             size = 5, colour = "grey40") +
    labs(x = x_lab, y = "log2 half-life FC (large / small cells)") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
          axis.text  = element_text(size = 11, colour = "black"))
}

n_pat1 <- sum(!is.na(df_merged$log2FC_pat1D) & !is.na(df_merged$WT_hl_fc))
n_lsm1 <- sum(!is.na(df_merged$log2FC_lsm1D) & !is.na(df_merged$WT_hl_fc))
n_dhh1 <- sum(!is.na(df_merged$log2FC_dhh1D) & !is.na(df_merged$WT_hl_fc))

p_pat1 <- make_scatter(df_merged, "log2FC_pat1D", r_pat1, n_pat1,
                       "log2 FC after pat1\u0394 (He et al. 2018)", col_large) +
  labs(tag = "A")

p_lsm1 <- make_scatter(df_merged, "log2FC_lsm1D", r_lsm1, n_lsm1,
                       "log2 FC after lsm1\u0394 (He et al. 2018)", col_large) +
  labs(tag = "B")

p_dhh1 <- make_scatter(df_merged, "log2FC_dhh1D", r_dhh1, n_dhh1,
                       "log2 FC after dhh1\u0394 (He et al. 2018)", col_large) +
  labs(tag = "C")

p_panel <- p_pat1 | p_lsm1 | p_dhh1
p_panel
ggsave("figures/He2018_decapping_scatter.png", p_panel,
       width = 18, height = 6, dpi = 150)
cat("Saved figures/He2018_decapping_scatter.png\n")
```

```{r save}
write.table(df_he2018, "tables/df_he2018_gba.txt",
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
cat("Saved tables/df_he2018_gba.txt\n")
```
